exposure.needed: whether Kyverno is upgraded without Helm or with Helm hooks disabled, and whether existing Kyverno custom resources are still stored at a dropped deprecated API version (the evidence's list of affected CRDs is truncated; rendered diffs show v2alpha1 removed from cleanuppolicies, clustercleanuppolicies and policyexceptions)

consequence.statement: Kyverno 1.13 drops deprecated API versions of its managed CRDs. A Helm hook handles the migration automatically, but installs upgraded without Helm or without the Helm hook must migrate existing resources themselves.
consequence.remediation: If you upgrade without Helm or with Helm hooks disabled, migrate existing Kyverno resources to the served API versions with kube-storage-version-migrator.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 drops deprecated API versions of its managed CRDs. A Helm hook migrates stored resources automatically, but installs upgraded without Helm or without the Helm hook need to migrate existing resources with kube-storage-version-migrator.
